summary.text: TEAM OSLO AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2022-02-04. TEAM OSLO AS operates a hotel. Its statutory purpose is to run hotels, guesthouses, restaurants, offices and commercial premises and all other activities connected therewith, including investments in companies with similar purposes. It was previously named KATAPULTSTART 13 AS until 2022-03-09. Its main industry code is 55.100: hotels and similar accommodation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 15 244 295 NOK and the annual result was -1 536 756 NOK; operating income was up from 13 372 953 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -2 557 001 NOK in 2024 to -1 536 756 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from -3 301 460 NOK in 2024 to -4 838 216 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Torgeir Flåteteigen Birkeland (daglig leder) and Terje Ropstad (styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 6 on 2026-03-12 to 8 on 2026-06-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-17 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
